topics.title: Basic economic problem: scarcity and exercise of choice

source.verbatim: 1.1 Basic economic problem: scarcity and exercise of choice

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the nature of the economic problem

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe the nature of the economic problem (limited resources and unlimited wants)
explain and illustrate opportunity cost
evaluate the implications of specific courses of action in terms of opportunity cost

topics.title: Types of economic systems and economic resources

source.verbatim: 1.2 Types of economic systems and economic resources

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate understanding of economic resources in different economic systems

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe the factors of production (land, labour, capital, entrepreneurship)
explain allocation of resources in market, planned and mixed economic systems
evaluate the merits and effectiveness of different economic systems

general_objectives.verbatim: appreciate the importance of specialisation and the division of labour

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain the meaning of specialisation and the division of labour
analyse the advantages and disadvantages of specialisation and the division of labour
discuss the various levels of specialisation (individual, regional, national)

content_outline.title: NATURE AND FUNCTIONS OF ORGANISATIONS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS

source.verbatim: THEME 2: NATURE AND FUNCTIONS OF ORGANISATIONS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the different forms of business organisations in the public and private sector

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain the differences between the private and public sector
describe the different forms of business organisations: sole proprietors, partnerships, private companies, public companies, multi-nationals, co-operatives, close corporations, public corporations
compare and choose the most appropriate form of business

general_objectives.verbatim: know and understand the role of trade unions in business organisations and the economy

specific_objectives.verbatim: define a trade union
identify the aims of trade unions
describe the advantages of joining a trade union
describe the types of trade unions in Namibia (e.g. white collar, blue collar, craft unions)
discuss the factors affecting trade union activities in Namibia
explain and evaluate the role of trade unions
explain the role of employer association

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of the importance and activities of financial institutions

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain the need for exchange
explain the functions, quality and types of money
define and calculate exchange rate
discuss the effects of fluctuating exchange rates on the economy
describe and evaluate the functions of central banks, stock exchanges and commercial banks

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of the role of a market

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain a market
explain different types of markets

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the principles of demand and supply

specific_objectives.verbatim: define and illustrate demand and supply
discuss and illustrate the principle of equilibrium price
analyse simple market situations with changes in supply and demand
discuss the causes of changes in demand and supply conditions
analyse such changes to show effects on price

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the concept of price elasticity

specific_objectives.verbatim: define price elasticity of demand and supply
discuss and apply price elasticity of demand and supply
perform simple calculations of elasticity and inelasticity of demand and supply

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of the role of advertising

specific_objectives.verbatim: define advertising
describe the purpose and methods of advertising

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the importance of pricing and output policies in business

specific_objectives.verbatim: discuss and evaluate pricing and output policies in perfect competition and monopoly

content_outline.title: OCCUPATION, INCOME AND EXPENDITURE OF INDIVIDUALS

source.verbatim: THEME 4: OCCUPATION, INCOME AND EXPENDITURE OF INDIVIDUALS

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge of factors affecting choice of occupation

specific_objectives.verbatim: differentiate between and discuss wage and non-wage factors affecting an individual’s choice of occupation

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of the factors determining earnings

specific_objectives.verbatim: identify and analyse the factors determining earnings

describe and explain the differences in earnings between different occupational groups and different economic sectors (male/female; skilled/unskilled; private/public; agricultural/manufacturing/ services)
analyse and discuss changes in earnings over time between occupations and between economic sectors
explain economic rent and transfer earnings

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge of spending, saving and borrowing

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe how and why different income groups have different expenditure patterns (spending, saving, borrowing)
analyse the different motives for spending, saving and borrowing
analyse and discuss changes in patterns of expenditure between groups and over a period of time

topics.title: The private firm as producer and employer

source.verbatim: 5.1 The private firm as producer and employer

general_objectives.verbatim: be familiar with the aims of firms
demonstrate understanding of production

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe and analyse the principle of profit maximisation as a goal
define production
describe what determines the demand for factors of production
analyse particular situations to show the effects of substituting one factor for another

general_objectives.verbatim: be familiar with the importance of productivity as a way of measuring performance

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain the meaning of productivity
show how productivity is measured
discuss how productivity can be improved
explain the effect of Information Technology on productivity
discuss the effects of HIV and AIDS on productivity

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge and skill in determining the costs of and revenue from production

specific_objectives.verbatim: define total, average, fixed and variable costs
define total and average revenue
discuss how costs and revenue might change as output changes
explain the effect of changes in technology on production

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of integration, economies and diseconomies of scale

specific_objectives.verbatim: define and identify the different types of integration
explain and illustrate the various economies of scale
explain and illustrate the various diseconomies of scale
discuss how the economies and diseconomies of scale affect business costs
discuss the main reasons for the different sizes of firms (size of market; capital; organisation), and the different factors that influence the size of a firm

content_outline.title: ROLE OF GOVERNMENT IN AN ECONOMY

source.verbatim: THEME 6: ROLE OF GOVERNMENT IN AN ECONOMY

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the role of government in production

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe the government as a producer of goods and services and as an employer

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of the economic policies of the government

specific_objectives.verbatim: define government economic policy
discuss the aims of government policy and why they should be achieved - full employment - prevention of inflation - economic growth - redistribution of income - balance of payments stability
explain fiscal and monetary policies of the government
describe the different types of taxes
discuss how taxes are used by the government to influence business activities and the role of the budget
describe how the government can use the interest rate to influence business activity

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge and understanding of the need for the control of business activity by the government

specific_objectives.verbatim: explain the reasons for government’s intervention in business
explain how the government controls production of goods and services
discuss how consumers are protected in Namibia
discuss how employees are protected by the State
discuss how the government can protect people with HIV and AIDS at the workplace

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge and understanding of the importance of economic indicators in an economy (recent changes and current trends)

specific_objectives.verbatim: define retail price index and show its simple calculation
describe different types of inflation
discuss the consequences of inflation

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge of aspects relating to employment and unemployment

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe and discuss the changing patterns and levels of employment
investigate the reasons for unemployment
investigate the consequences of unemployment
investigate remedies to unemployment

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge on how to measure output and the reasons for measuring output

specific_objectives.verbatim: define Gross Domestic Product, Gross National Product and National Income
describe the different methods of calculating the national income
explain reasons for measuring the national income

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge of the importance of international trade

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe the changing patterns of exports and imports and the effects on the balance of payments
discuss exchange rates and give reasons for their fluctuations
demonstrate the simple application of absolute and comparative advantage in trade

general_objectives.verbatim: acquire knowledge and understanding relating to population

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe developed and developing economies and reasons for different stages of development
discuss problems and consequences for developing countries as they develop
describe the factors that affect population growth (birth rate, death rate, fertility rate, net migration) and reasons for rates of growth in Namibia and other countries
discuss the effects of changing size and structure of population on an economy

general_objectives.verbatim: understand the effect of economic activity on living standards

specific_objectives.verbatim: describe simple measures and indicators of comparative living standards
describe differences in living standards and discuss reasons for disparities within nations and between nations, both developed and developing countries
explain the effect of Information Technology on living standards

general_objectives.verbatim: demonstrate an understanding of possible conflicts between the aims of individuals, firms and government

specific_objectives.verbatim: discuss conflicts of interest in relation to: - social costs* and benefits, private costs and benefits - short/long term costs and benefits - conserving resources versus exploiting resources - free trade versus protection - public expenditure versus private expenditure
